questions.question: What is React.js?
questions.answer: React is a JavaScript library used to create user interfaces. It uses components to build web pages.

questions.question: What is Node.js?
questions.answer: Node.js is used to run JavaScript outside the browser. I have basic knowledge about it.

questions.question: How would you connect a React application to a backend API?
questions.answer: I would use fetch or Axios to send requests to the API. The response can be displayed in the React application.
